_comment: 2D box in the DIFFUSIVE regime, the 2D twin of slab_diffusive.json: Sigma_t 100 over cells of width 0.1, so ten mean free paths per cell, with a scattering ratio of 0.99. This is the regime the removal + AIR composite has nothing to say about and the DSA diffusion correction does - it is the problem the 2D -precon_dsa pins are measured on. 50x50 keeps it CI-sized. All four faces vacuum, so the diffusion operator is nonsingular whatever the ratio.
